pages.text: The Twilight Forest is the primary T2 adventure dimension. Bosses, structures, and the first Simply Swords uniques.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Twilight Forest is the most content-dense T2 dimension. Seven bosses with unique weapons, a full progression path through the forest, and some of the best T2 loot tables.$(br2)$(bold)Boss order:$(/bold) The forest has an internal progression. You cannot reach late zones without defeating earlier bosses. Follow the magic map or FTB Quests for the intended order.

$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$(/bold) Twilight structure chests have had diamonds removed. Tokens and T2 materials replace them. The forest's original loot has been preserved otherwise — Steeleaf and Ironwood armor are valid T2 gear choices.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight materials:$(/bold) Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery, Knightmetal are all valid T2 gear materials.

$(bold)No guide book.$(/bold) Twilight Forest is largely self-guided — each biome leads naturally to the next boss. The $(bold)Magic Map$(/bold) (crafted from a map + 4 diamonds) reveals the full dimension layout and boss locations.
